old_graphic.alt: One adult claps to attract attention while another reaches for a plate of food.
old_graphic.caption: A distraction while the meal is taken.
old_graphic.creator: Project Odisha

new_graphic.alt: Two sequential panels show the same man clapping to distract diners, then running away with their plate of food.
new_graphic.caption: An imagined sequence shows one person creating the distraction and taking the meal.
new_graphic.creator: Project Odisha

old_graphic.alt: At a meeting table, one man gestures expansively while a similar-looking man bows his head beside him; an older visitor stands in the doorway.
old_graphic.caption: An imagined contrast sets bold talk beside hesitation when an imposing visitor arrives.

new_graphic.alt: Two sequential panels show the same man boasting at a table, then lowering his head when an imposing visitor arrives.
new_graphic.caption: An imagined meeting turns bold talk into timidity when a visitor arrives.

old_graphic.alt: Two people stand beside a broken stone grinding vessel and its cylindrical tool at a doorway.
old_graphic.caption: An imagined household scene shows useful equipment damaged by misplaced anger.

new_graphic.alt: Two people look toward a cracked flat stone grinding slab and its cylindrical roller beside a doorway.
new_graphic.caption: An imagined aftermath shows a useful grinding slab damaged by misplaced anger.

old_graphic.alt: Three adults discuss an open book beside an empty stool and a plate.
old_graphic.caption: An imagined discussion that examines a bodily taunt rather than repeating its judgment.

new_graphic.alt: An overfull diner begins to rise from a cracked low stool beside emptied meal dishes.
new_graphic.caption: An imagined exaggeration shows the meal ending only as the diner rises from a cracked stool.

old_graphic.alt: Two workers pause beside an unfinished wooden frame while one examines sparsely stocked shelves.
old_graphic.caption: An imagined workshop pauses where the means to continue run short.

new_graphic.alt: Two sequential panels show a craftworker buying decorative vases, then examining his empty purse beside unfinished work and bare shelves.
new_graphic.caption: An imagined purchase leaves the workshop short of money for later needs.
